steps.reasoning: The user asks to write a polite email apologizing to a customer for a delayed hardware replacement. This is a writing task, not a data query. We just need to produce the email content. No need to use any tools. Provide a polite email.
steps.text:
Subject: Apology for the Delay in Your Hardware Replacement  

Dear [Customer Name],

I hope you are doing well. I am writing to sincerely apologize for the delay in delivering the replacement hardware you requested. We understand how important this equipment is to your operations, and we regret any inconvenience this has caused.

The delay was due to an unexpected supply‑chain issue that impacted the arrival of the replacement unit. Please rest assured that we have taken immediate steps to expedite the shipment, and your replacement is now scheduled to arrive by **[expected delivery date]**. We will also provide you with a tracking number as soon as the package is dispatched so you can monitor its progress.

We truly value your partnership with us, and we appreciate your patience and understanding while we resolve this matter. If there is anything else we can do to support you in the meantime, please do not hesitate to let us know.

Thank you for giving us the opportunity to make this right.

Kind regards,

[Your Name]  
[Your Title]  
[Your Company]  
[Phone Number]  
[Email Address]
